answer: Like mycelium routing nutrients through soil, decentralized trust must crystallize along verified paths of shared work. Cloned identities that wander aimlessly across our peer topology face superlinear staking requirements for consensus weight. A malicious actor seeking to forge consensus cannot sprout cheaply; each synthetic identity multiplies collateral requirements by an exponential power of cluster density, exhausting attacker reserves as naturally as a drought withers a counterfeit juniper root.
